2.011 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLING
MGUEEXPRSDAFTN011
Start_IMS
OBJECTIVE:
Dust and Aerosol measurement Feasibility Test (DAFT). This procedure utilizes an ambient air
sample from ISS for measurement by the P-Trak and DustTrak. It initiates the P-Trak and
DustTrak for sampling and shutdown.
STATION PARTS:
DAFT Accessories Kit P/N DAFT-0700
DustTrak P/N DAFT-0201
P-Trak-01 P/N DAFT-0101
Single Strap P/N PERS0041
Cable Straps [6] P/N 528-43074-1
NOTE
1. DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLING alternates between
both the P-Trak and DustTrak hardware units.
2. This procedure contains Near Real-Time video downlink or LAB VTR
recording requirements.
3. AOS required for POIC to configure onboard system for downlink or
LAB VTR recording.
1. DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLING SETUP
1.1 Retrieve DustTrak.
Start Video Activity
1.2 If video is required,
Perform {P/TV 584 DAFT}.
NOTE
1. DustTrak takes approximately ten seconds to warm up prior
to use.
2. DustTrak displays during warm up appear quickly. DustTrak
displays must be checked immediately after powering on the
unit and at the end of the display sequence.
DustTrak 1.3 pb ON/OFF → Press
06May04 N011-1 DAFT/PB3-01-0677A

2.011 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLING
MGUEEXPRSDAFTN011
1.4 Verify DustTrak battery display is above 40%.
1.5 Tmpry stow DustTrak.
1.6 Retrieve P-Trak-01.
NOTE
P-Trak-01 takes approximately one minute to warm up prior to
use.
P-Trak-01 1.7 pb ON/OFF → Press
1.8 After P-Trak-01 has warmed up (one minute),
√Displays are active and visible
√Particles per cubic centimeter (PT/CC) display is active and
reading (upper portion of screen)
√Battery power indicator is at least half full (lower right corner of
screen)
* ********************************************************
* If P-Trak-01 is not in the listed states,
* pb ON/OFF → Press (off)
* Unstow P-Trak Batteries.
* Remove used P-Trak Batteries.
* Dispose of P-Trak Batteries in appropriate trash.
* Replace with new P-Trak Batteries.
* pb ON/OFF → Press (on)
* √P-Trak-01 Displays
* If still no joy,
*
* √POIC
*
*
********************************************************
1.9 Verify no visual warnings appear (lower left corner of screen) or
audible warnings occur.
1.10 Tmpry stow P-Trak-01.
06May04 N011-2 DAFT/PB3-01-0677A

2.011 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLING
MGUEEXPRSDAFTN011
NOTE
1. DustTrak displays appear immediately after pressing buttons on the
unit then displays fade.
2. Test ID information from DustTrak must be logged.
3. DustTrak Xµm Adapter will be used for DustTrak 10µm Adapter,
DustTrak 2.5µm Adapter or DustTrak 1µm Adapter.
2. DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK INITIATION
2.1 Retrieve DustTrak.
DustTrak 2.2 pb SAMPLING MODE → Press once
√LOG 1 is visible (upper middle portion of screen)
2.3 pb SAMPLE → Press
√TEST ID number
2.4 √DustTrak display is RECORDING
* ****************************************************************
* If DustTrak display does not display RECORDING
* Repeat steps 2.2 and 2.3.
*
* If still no joy,
*
* √POIC
*
* ****************************************************************
2.5 Log TEST ID number from DustTrak on
DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLE LOG.
P-Trak-01 2.6 pb Down arrow → Press twice
√LOG MODE 1 is visible (lower left portion of screen)
2.7 pb ↵ (Enter) → Press
√LOG MODE 1 is visible (lower left portion of screen)
√↵ TO STOP is visible (lower right portion of screen)
2.8 Log TEST ID number from P-Trak-01 on
DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLE LOG.
2.9 Retrieve the DAFT Accessories Kit.
06May04 N011-3 DAFT/PB3-01-0677A

2.011 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLING
MGUEEXPRSDAFTN011
DAFT Accessories 2.10 Unstow:
Kit P-Trak HEPA Filter
DAFT HEPA Filter
2.11 Tmpry stow:
DAFT HEPA Filter
DAFT Accessories Kit
P-Trak-01 2.12 Connect P-Trak HEPA Filter to P-Trak-01.
P-Trak HEPA Filter hose end →|← P-Trak Hose Adapter
2.13 Retrieve DAFT HEPA Filter.
DustTrak 2.14 Connect DAFT HEPA Filter to DustTrak.
DAFT HEPA Filter hose end →|← DustTrak Xµm Adapter
per Execution Notes
2.15 Wait 15 seconds.
P-Trak-01 2.16 Verify particles per cubic centimeter (PT/CC) display: <10
(upper portion of screen).
DustTrak 2.17 Verify milligrams per meters cubed (mg/m3) display:
-0.001 to 0.003 (left prominent display).
P-Trak-01 2.18 Disconnect P-Trak HEPA Filter from P-Trak-01.
P-Trak HEPA Filter hose end ←|→ P-Trak Hose Adapter
DustTrak 2.19 Disconnect DAFT HEPA Filter from DustTrak.
DAFT HEPA Filter hose end ←|→ DustTrak Xµm Adapter
per Execution Notes
2.20 Tmpry stow:
P-Trak HEPA Filter
DAFT HEPA Filter
P-Trak-01
DustTrak
* ****************************************************************
* If continuous beeping is heard from P-Trak-01 or
* DustTrak,
*
* √POIC for ground troubleshooting
*
* ****************************************************************
06May04 N011-4 DAFT/PB3-01-0677A

2.011 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLING
MGUEEXPRSDAFTN011
3. DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLING
3.1 Retrieve DAFT Accessories Kit.
DAFT Accessories 3.2 Unstow DAFT Sample Hose.
Kit Tmpry stow DAFT Accessories Kit.
3.3 Retrieve P-Trak-01.
P-Trak-01 3.4 Connect DAFT Sample Hose to P-Trak-01.
To P-Trak Hose Adapter →|← P-Trak Hose Adapter
3.5 Retrieve DustTrak.
DustTrak 3.6 Connect DAFT Sample Hose to DustTrak.
To DustTrak Adapter →|← DustTrak Xµm Adapter
per Execution Notes
NOTE
1. The Single Strap and Cable Straps can be used for a
secure setup for DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK Sampling
when the sample location is stationary.
2. {5.011 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK CONFIGURATION
WITH VELCRO RESTRAINTS} can be used as reference
for a stationary setup.
3.7 √P-Trak-01 and DustTrak with DAFT Sample Hose are secured
together
Refer to {5.009 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK HARDWARE
ASSEMBLY}.
NOTE
1. Execution Notes will provide sample location for Sampling.
2. Sampling will take approximately six minutes to complete.
P-Trak-01 3.8 √Particles per cubic centimeter (PT/CC) displays active
and Sample Extraction is recording (upper portion of screen)
DustTrak 3.9 √Milligrams per meters cubed (mg/m3) displays active
and Sample Extraction is recording (left prominent display)
3.10 Log GMT on DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLE LOG.
3.11 Using P-Trak-01 and DustTrak, sample ambient air per
Execution Notes for approximately six minutes.
06May04 N011-5 DAFT/PB3-01-0677A

2.011 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLING
MGUEEXPRSDAFTN011
3.12 Log ambient air sample location on
DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLE LOG.
End Video Activity
4. DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLING SHUTDOWN
P-Trak-01 4.1 Disconnect DAFT Sample Hose from P-Trak-01.
To P-Trak Hose Adapter ←|→ P-Trak Hose Adapter
DustTrak 4.2 Disconnect DAFT Sample Hose from DustTrak.
To DustTrak Adapter ←|→ DustTrak Xµm Adapter
per Execution Notes
4.3 Tmpry stow DAFT Sample Hose.
4.4 Retrieve P-Trak HEPA Filter.
P-Trak-01 4.5 Connect P-Trak HEPA Filter to P-Trak-01.
P-Trak HEPA Filter hose end →|← P-Trak Hose Adapter
4.6 Retrieve DAFT HEPA Filter.
DustTrak 4.7 Connect DAFT HEPA Filter to DustTrak.
DAFT HEPA Filter hose end →|← DustTrak Xµm Adapter
per Execution Notes
4.8 Wait 15 seconds.
4.9 Verify particles per cubic centimeter (PT/CC) display: <10
(upper portion of screen).
4.10 Verify milligrams per meters cubed (mg/m3) display:
-0.001 to 0.003 (left prominent display).
P-Trak-01 4.11 Disconnect P-Trak HEPA Filter from P-Trak-01.
P-Trak HEPA Filter hose end ←|→ P-Trak Hose Adapter
DustTrak 4.12 Disconnect DAFT HEPA Filter from DustTrak.
DAFT HEPA Filter hose end ←|→ DustTrak Xµm Adapter
per Execution Notes
4.13 Tmpry stow:
P-Trak HEPA Filter
DAFT HEPA Filter
P-Trak-01 4.14 pb ↵ (Enter) → Press
pb ON/OFF → Press
√P-Trak power − Off
06May04 N011-6 DAFT/PB3-01-0677A

2.011 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK SAMPLING
MGUEEXPRSDAFTN011
DustTrak 4.15 pb SAMPLE → Press
pb ON/OFF → Press
√DustTrak power − Off
4.16 √P-Trak-01 and DustTrak are secure
4.17 Retrieve:
DAFT Accessories Kit
P-Trak HEPA Filter
DAFT HEPA Filter
DAFT Sample Hose
DAFT Accessories 4.18 Stow:
Kit P-Trak HEPA Filter
DAFT HEPA Filter
DAFT Sample Hose
4.19 Stow or Tmpry stow DAFT Accessories Kit.
RESTOW tools, parts, materials, as required, to original locations:
06May04 N011-7 DAFT/PB3-01-0677A
